title: Concrete Gospel
description: DaemonV12 First Listening Benchmark. 16 bars, 144 BPM halftime, F minor. Rack/Timbre Lab stems (reed, choir, Living Bass 808, kick layers, room) mixed with V12 Signature drums and steel.

tracks.description: V12 IRON PULSE tuned to C2 and gated, layered with the rack skin punch (F2) and log rim click stems.
V12 TITANIUM CRACK (down a semitone) stacked with NEON CLAP on the halftime backbeat.
V12 GHOST TICK eighths, written rolls and OPEN CIRCUIT, one choke group.
V12 CHROME STRIKE at F4 + F3: the bell that marks bars 1, 5, 13 and the end.
The same bell gated short on C5/F5: a sparse steel off-beat figure.
Living Bass played as a tuned sliding 808 (rack stem), ducked under every kick.
The breath reed hook behind the concrete wall (bars 1-4 only).
The breath reed hook, full band from bar 5.
Three impossible voices behind the wall (bars 1-4).
The same voices in the room: the bar-12 major answer and the last amen.
The rack room (FDN) on the reed and choir, behind the wall.
The rack room, full band from bar 5.
